title: MotorPulse AI Synthetic Motor Feature Events
citation: MotorPulse AI contributors. MotorPulse-AI (software-first motor simulation), version 0.1.0.dev0. https://github.com/yousseffaouzi/MotorPulse-AI

license.original_or_derived_redistribution: no third-party inputs; review any use-specific output terms independently

collection.method: seeded simulated acceleration, temperature, RPM and fault schedules; exported per-asset derived features
collection.temporal_timestamps: UTC virtual timestamps, distinct from real export time
collection.actual_independent_runs: different seeds are not proven independent physical conditions

labels.motor_fault: controlled synthetic scenario (healthy/imbalance/bearing_wear/misalignment/overload), not diagnosed machine failure
labels.sensor_quality: injected good/missing/outlier condition, not instrument certification
labels.health: uncalibrated rule-based normal/warning/critical or unavailable/suspect; not ML output

measurement_quality.missingness: JSON null vibration when sensor_quality=missing; CSV blank; never coerce to healthy/zero
measurement_quality.outliers: synthetically injected sensor impulses are not verified machine faults

recommended_splits: Group complete generator runs and asset histories; do not split repeated seed/config/clock source across partitions; purged same-run chronological split only exploratory.
intended_uses: Teaching signal processing and data engineering
Testing software contracts and synthetic data pipelines
Prototyping classical anomaly-detection methods with clearly labeled simulated truth
excluded_uses: Diagnosing or controlling real rotating equipment
Estimating actual failure probability or RUL
Reporting synthetic classifier performance as field predictive-maintenance accuracy
known_limitations: No physically calibrated motor or bearing geometry, sensor transfer function, or real field failure logs
Seeded runs may share generator assumptions and programmed fault patterns
Temperature/load patterns and heuristic health thresholds are educational fixtures
No physical validation, measurement uncertainty calibration or industrial safety assurance

rights_review.notes: Code MIT license does not itself establish a separately issued dataset license.
